meta.short: IFRS 7 and IAS 1 - presentation and disclosure
meta.title: IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements (1.82(a)) and IFRS 7 Financial Instruments: Disclosures (7.20, 7.34(c), 7.35A to 7.35M) - the lines and disclosures the system produces
meta.basis: As of 14 October 2026: the report catalogue (29 reports in the Reports hub, rendered by ifrs9:smoke-reports), the IFRS 9 note (/ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure), the EIR as at a date, the RBM Return, the scenario sets and the stress runs, at commit abe140d; figures from the fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 of 13 October 2026 (before commit 216aee2), read with SELECTs only.
meta.source: IAS 1.82(a) (interest revenue calculated using the effective interest method presented separately); IFRS 7.20 (income, expense, gains and losses), 7.34(c) (concentrations of risk), 7.35A to 7.35M (credit risk: practices, inputs and assumptions, the allowance reconciliation 7.35H, changes in the gross carrying amount 7.35I, collateral 7.35K, write-off 7.35L, exposure by grade 7.35M). Spec v4 sections 6.11, 12, 15.7.

rows.section_name: Interest revenue at the effective interest method as its own line
rows.requirement: The statement of profit or loss presents interest revenue calculated using the effective interest method separately.
rows.engine_comment: The EIR as at a date gives the EIR interest, the contractual interest posted and the difference for any period to any date, by product, by GL and in total, with CSV, Excel and PDF; the GL reconciliation ties the contractual interest to the ledger. It covers only the loans with a locked EIR: 14 of 144 contracts on the fresh bootstrap (13 with roll-forward rows from July 2024 to September 2026). The revenue shift for 2024 and 2025 across the book (spec P9) is not yet computed.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 this row was marked Done.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: the line is produced for the loans with a locked EIR; the book's figure needs the remaining EIRs locked (fee reviews) and the P9 run.
rows.where_to_see: EIR Calculations, EIR as at a Date: /eir-as-at; GL Reconciliation: /eir-reconciliation

rows.requirement: Disclose total interest revenue calculated using the effective interest method for financial assets at amortised cost.
rows.engine_comment: As IAS 1.82(a): the book view's EIR interest year to date, for the loans with a locked EIR only.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was marked Done.

rows.section_name: Gain or loss on derecognition of amortised-cost assets
rows.requirement: Disclose the gain or loss on derecognition and the reasons.
rows.engine_comment: The IFRS 9 note's section (h) discloses the carrying amount derecognised on a substantial modification and the gain or loss on it, from the restructure register as the revenue run applied it (RestructureRegisterService::ifrs7Disclosures; the 10 percent test against the governed modification_threshold, and the qualitative factors, in ModificationAccountingService), on the screen and in the PDF, Word, Excel and CSV. A candidate found in E-Banker's reschedule history is never disclosed until two people confirm it: the note counts them instead. On the scratch clone maiic_ifrs9_wire of 14 October 2026 (a copy of the restructure build's database, migrated): 0 confirmed, 70 candidates awaiting classification, so the line is nil and says so. A derecognition by sale or transfer has no record in the system.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was Outstanding: modification and derecognition on modification were not built.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: built and wired to the note; MAIIC classifies and approves the candidates, and confirms that no loan was sold or transferred.
rows.where_to_see: Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure (h); EIR Data, Restructures & Resets: /eir-restructures

rows.requirement: Explain how the entity determines a significant increase in credit risk and default, how instruments were grouped, and the write-off policy.
rows.engine_comment: The staging thresholds by facility class with their rebuttal basis, the missed-instalment trigger, the cure period, the SICR groups, the PD and LGD segmentation and the 61 catalogue settings are in the system with their rationale, and the IFRS 9 note writes its policy text from them. The write-off policy is MAIIC's to state; the write-off classifier and register exist (220a5a6).
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 the row said 48 governed settings.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: the write-off policy is evidence awaited.
rows.where_to_see: Governance: Governance Centre /eir-governance; Settings, Staging basis: /setting?tab=staging; Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure

rows.section_name: Inputs, assumptions and estimation techniques; sensitivity
rows.requirement: Explain the basis of inputs and assumptions, how forward-looking information was incorporated, and changes from the previous period.
rows.engine_comment: The scenario set stores its sensitivity (the ECL under each scenario, weighted) and the stress runs save the ECL under each scenario; the transmission method cards explain the forward-looking route; the IFRS 9 note writes its assumptions from the governed settings. The hub's Sensitivity entry now redirects to Stress Testing.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 the test cited was the scenario set's approval test.
rows.where_to_see: Forward-Looking Information, Scenario Sets: /scenario-sets; Stress Testing: /stress-testing; Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure

rows.requirement: Reconcile the opening to the closing loss allowance by class, showing changes from staging transfers, originations, derecognitions, write-offs and remeasurement.
rows.engine_comment: The IFRS 9 note reconciles opening to closing by stage with transfers, new assets, derecognitions, write-offs and remeasurement, and refuses a download unless every check passes (EclMovementAttribution). Since 14 October 2026: the allowance is the booked (discounted) allowance with a table from the undiscounted measure (projection, discounting effect), and the note fails closed while any loan lacks its discounted figure; the write-off line carries the allowance each write-off used, from the ledger's write-offs (WriteOffClassifier) and the approved register (WriteOffSource), and the ECL Reconciliation export and the hub's bridge and charge carry the same. December 2025 to September 2026 on the fresh bootstrap: 20 contracts written off, using 22,262,632.66 of allowance (it had shown nil); 38 loans at September 2026 have no discounted figure, so the note is not yet issuable.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 this row was marked Done, with nil write-offs and the undiscounted allowance.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: built; the note is issuable once the 38 loans carry their discounted allowance.
rows.where_to_see: Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure; ECL Reconciliation: /ifrs9-reports/ecl-reconciliation and /report/ecl-reconciliation

rows.section_name: Changes in the gross carrying amount that contributed to changes in the allowance
rows.requirement: Explain how significant changes in the gross carrying amount contributed to changes in the loss allowance.
rows.engine_comment: The loan book of every month from July 2024 holds the gross carrying amount derived from the ledger with its provenance; the IFRS 9 note's gross table and the Gross Movement report render. Since 14 October 2026 the gross write-off line of the note and the Loan Book Reconciliation's written-off line (with the list) read the ledger's write-offs and the approved register (WriteOffSource); the filter on contract_status that never matched is gone. December 2025 to September 2026: 38,492,032.54 written off (TRF 3 of 29 June 2026).
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 the write-off line was always nil.
rows.where_to_see: Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure; Gross Movement /ifrs9-reports/gross-movement; Loan Book Reconciliation /report/loan-book-reconciliation; Disbursements /report/disbursement-report

rows.requirement: (a) For assets modified in the period while the loss allowance was lifetime ECL: the amortised cost before the modification and the net modification gain or loss; (b) the gross carrying amount at the reporting date of assets modified since initial recognition while on lifetime ECL whose allowance changed to 12-month ECL in the period.
rows.engine_comment: The IFRS 9 note's section (h) gives 35J(a) (count, amortised cost before, net gain or loss), 35J(b) (count and gross carrying amount at the closing month, for loans on lifetime ECL in the period after the modification and on 12-month ECL at its end) and, beside them, the IFRS 9 5.4.3 gain or loss on every modification and the B5.4.6 catch-up, for the period from the day after the opening month-end to the closing month-end, in the note's portfolio scope, from the modifications the revenue run applied (RestructureRegisterService::ifrs7Disclosures). With none it says so; a confirmed modification the revenue run has not applied, or stopped, fails the note's check, so the note is not issued with the disclosure incomplete; the candidates awaiting confirmation are counted, never disclosed. On the scratch clone maiic_ifrs9_wire of 14 October 2026 (a copy of the restructure build's database, migrated): nothing confirmed, 70 candidates awaiting, so the section reads nil with that count.
rows.compliance_comment: Compliant: the figures follow once MAIIC confirms a modification.

rows.requirement: Disclose the effect of collateral on the amount of the loss allowance and the nature of the collateral held.
rows.engine_comment: The E-Banker security register (P2_11, 185 rows) is landed and the collateral screens exist with a checked import; on the fresh bootstrap collateral_registers and collateral_allocations are empty, and the LGD engine reads no collateral, so its effect on the allowance cannot be shown.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was Evidence needed; the LGD link is also Dupleix's.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: Credit supplies the security and valuations; Dupleix links collateral to the LGD.
rows.where_to_see: Collateral Management, Collateral Register: /collateral/register; Reports: LGD and collateral /ifrs9-reports/lgd-collateral

rows.section_name: Written-off assets still subject to enforcement
rows.requirement: Disclose the contractual amount outstanding on assets written off in the period that are still subject to enforcement activity.
rows.engine_comment: Ledger write-offs are classified (22 of 60,778,466.86 on the fresh bootstrap) and the register records any other; the IFRS 9 note lists the write-offs of the period contract by contract and, since 14 October 2026, states the 7.35L amount as not recorded, because neither E-Banker nor the register holds an enforcement status, rather than showing nil.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2). Until 14 October 2026 this row said no write-off had been posted since the take-on, and the note was silent on 7.35L.
rows.compliance_comment: Partially done: Finance states which written-off accounts are under enforcement; Dupleix adds the field and the amount.
rows.where_to_see: EIR Data, Write-offs: /eir-write-offs; Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure (g)

rows.section_name: Credit risk exposure by credit-risk rating grade and stage
rows.requirement: Disclose the gross carrying amount by credit risk rating grade, separately for 12-month and lifetime ECL (Stage 1, 2, 3).
rows.engine_comment: The IFRS 9 note and the RBM Classification report present the book by stage and by RBM class (days past due by term). The internal grades are not populated (internal_grade_code is null on every main-book loan on the fresh bootstrap; 0 internal grade profiles), so the grade used is the days-past-due class, which IFRS 7 B8I allows where past-due information is the basis of the SICR assessment.
rows.general_comment: Fresh bootstrap maiic_ifrs9_results2 (13 October 2026, before commit 216aee2).
rows.where_to_see: Reports: IFRS 9 note (FS disclosure) /ifrs9-reports/fs-disclosure; RBM Classification /ifrs9-reports/rbm-classification; Stage Allocation /ifrs9-reports/stage-allocation

rows.requirement: Disclose concentrations of risk if not otherwise apparent.
rows.engine_comment: The Concentration and large exposures report gives single-name and portfolio concentration (HHI) by sector, product and borrower; the sector and product-group ECL reports render.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 this row was referenced 7.35N (the provision-matrix paragraph) and cited an unrelated test.
rows.where_to_see: Reports: Concentration and large exposures /ifrs9-reports/concentration; Sector ECL /ifrs9-reports/sector-ecl
rows.test: ifrs9:smoke-reports (renders every hub report; no PHPUnit test of this report)

rows.requirement: The disclosures and the figures behind them handed to the auditor as one archive with a manifest.
rows.engine_comment: compliance:audits --pack={period} bundles the workbooks, the EIR as at the period end, the baselines and the ECL by stage with a SHA-256 per file in manifest.json; the Auditor Pack screen lists the packs with their manifest counts and hands one out.
rows.general_comment: Until 14 October 2026 the test cited was unrelated.

findings.finding: Collateral for the active accounts and the LGD link
findings.what_was_found: The collateral register is empty on the fresh bootstrap and the LGD reads no collateral (the request to Credit of 7 October covered 31 active accounts with no security).
findings.impact: The collateral disclosure and the LGD rest on nothing yet.
findings.recommended_action: Credit supplies the security and valuations; Dupleix adds collateral to the LGD.

findings.finding: No write-off policy in the system
findings.what_was_found: The write-off classifier and register exist (220a5a6), but MAIIC's policy and the enforcement status of written-off accounts are not held.
findings.impact: The practices disclosure and 7.35L are incomplete.
findings.recommended_action: Finance supplies the policy and the enforcement list; the help centre carries the policy.

findings.finding: Write-offs are nil in the note and the reconciliations
findings.what_was_found: Ifrs9NoteService marks no loan written off; EclReconciliationService hard-codes 0; LoanBookReconciliationService filters a status text that never occurs. 22 ledger write-offs of 60,778,466.86 are classified on the fresh bootstrap. Status 14 October 2026: done; all three (and the hub's bridge and charge) read WriteOffSource.

findings.finding: EIR interest covers the locked loans only
findings.what_was_found: 14 of 144 contracts carry a locked EIR on the fresh bootstrap; the 2024 and 2025 revenue shift for the book (P9) is not computed.
findings.impact: The EIR interest line is not yet the book's.
findings.recommended_action: Lock the remaining EIRs after the fee reviews; run P9.
